prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select a pet template or custom path with live animation previews.", "Select Species"]
1: ["Verify Your Custom Pet", "Review how your custom pet will render on your desktop before final adoption.", "Looks Great, Adopt!", "Confirm Pet Appearance"]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "Your pet is getting ready to move onto your desktop screen."]
3: []
4: ["Upload Clear Single-Subject Photos", "For best pet rendering results, upload a well-lit photo of one pet looking directly at the camera.", "Avoid blurry images, group photos, or low lighting to prevent generation errors."]
5: ["Tip: Right-click your desktop pet or system tray icon anytime to open controls or hide your pet."]
6: ["Signing back in? Use your existing account email to instantly restore all saved pets and progress."]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Complete adoption now to receive an exclusive starter badge and accessory pack for your pet.", "Founding Companion Badge"]
8: ["Don't worry about picking the wrong path—you can change or add new pets anytime in settings."]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Here are quick shortcuts to interact with your pet right on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for menu | Double-click to speak | Drag to relocate", "Start Interacting"]

verdicts.problem: Promises exclusive free extras and uses urgency tactics to push completing adoption.
